description: Configure Resend signing and the send return-path subdomain after Sophie has verified domain ownership. Does not configure inbound mail or replace apex MX records.
variableDescription: region is one of us-east-1, eu-west-1, sa-east-1, ap-northeast-1 and must match the provider's stored MX record. dkim is the provider's stored public key excluding p=. Other provider record shapes use manual setup.
